scope: Saved common 1.5-second native policy panels only; no harness, separate 4-second diagnostic, assisted or partial runs pooled.

metric_definitions.pickup: Saved verified lift plus contact during the attempt, with bilateral contact independently observed at least 70 mm above initial height. No gripper-close-only credit.
metric_definitions.new_placement: Initially outside target; final XY <=15 mm, full footprint inside target, face up, supported at correct height, released and stable. Yaw success is scored separately.
metric_definitions.orientation: Absolute directed yaw error [0,180] degrees; <=10 degrees passes. Mean across six unfinished cases, including the correction case.
metric_definitions.completed_without_pickup: No verified pickup in the two initially completed cases; does not establish learned completion recognition or absence of arm motion.
metric_definitions.object_undisturbed: New trajectory diagnostic: displacement never exceeds 2 mm and yaw change never exceeds 2 degrees, with no verified pickup. Not a replacement for frozen success.
metric_definitions.improvement: Initial-to-final error reduction describes within-episode progress, not improvement against a missing matched vanilla baseline.

suite_comparison.earlier: 40/model: 20 feeding and 20 loading, standard and varied goals; matched vanilla available.
suite_comparison.latest: 8/model: 5 transfer starts (1 source, 2 held-out personal, 2 synthetic), 1 wrong-orientation, 2 completed; feeding only. Common full-intent 1.5-second request; no matched vanilla.
suite_comparison.unchanged: 15 mm position / 10 degree yaw criteria and other physical success tolerances; 1500 total steps at 20 Hz. Same provisional 50 x 35 x 30 mm, 80 g physical body.
suite_comparison.limitations: Small diagnostic panel; whole-intent wording at 1.5 seconds is a declared request-distribution shift. V2-V4 use an explicit held-state annotation condition. Not a definitive variant ranking.
